**Slides.** [Open the deck at this part](../../slides/eu-frames-one-day-data-tools.html#/part-2-the-toolchain){target="_blank"} in its own tab, or follow it on the [slides page](slides.qmd).
:::

Part 2 is R itself and the IDE in which you write it. The R tutorial is worked live, a slide at a time; the IDE follows in six steps on the screen of the facilitator; and the part ends with a session of your own on the panel, in the browser lab or in your IDE.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Slides, the R tutorial, with [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) as the companion | Ten slides, typed along: R in one slide, getting data in, inspecting the data, working with rows and columns, model formulas, fixed effects with fixest, reading what comes back, plotting with tinyplot, causal graphs in R, and common error messages. | 35 minutes |
| Slides, the IDE step by step, with [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) as the companion | Open the folder, run the check, read the panel and view it, filter the view, draw one figure, render the report. In the workspace if you installed it; otherwise follow on the screen and do the middle three steps in the browser lab. | 20 minutes |
| An editable cell of [Browser lab](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd) Task 2, or the working script of the workspace | Hands-on 2: peek at the panel, keep one country and three columns, summarise it by year, draw one figure; then change one thing in each step and read what comes back. | 30 minutes |

**By the end of the part** you have read a data frame, filtered it, summarised it and drawn it in R, and you know where each of these happens in an IDE.
